name: aiops-agent
description: Monitor AI coding tool session costs locally — no API required

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && npx esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --external:better-sqlite3 --external:fsevents --format=cjs --define:import.meta.url=__filename --outfile=dist/cli.cjs && node -e "if(process.platform!=='win32')require('fs').chmodSync('dist/cli.cjs',0o755)"
scripts.prepare: npm run build 2>/dev/null || node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('dist/cli.cjs')){console.error('ERROR: dist/cli.cjs not found. Try: rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install');process.exit(1)}"
